name: GoodDollar GoodCompoundStaking COMP reward swap sandwich
summary: GoodCompoundStakingV2 sold its claimed COMP rewards on Uniswap V2 with zero minimum output, capped only by a share of the pool's spot reserve. The attacker dumped borrowed COMP into the pool, called collectInterest listing the staking clone five times to sell all rewards at the crashed price, then bought the COMP back.
notes: The defect is the staking clone's unprotected reward swap, whose cap the attacker inflated by first dumping COMP into the pool. GoodFundManager accepting the clone five times only repeated the capped sale; a single call was already profitable, so GoodFundManager is not a target.

The clone was created with maxLiquidityPercentageSwap 0, which makes every reward swap zero; the owner Safe raised it to 300 (slot 0xd2). A threshold the exploit needed is HIGH under rule 10, so that change is the reset.

Loss is the accrued COMP the clone claimed from Compound and sold at the manipulated price; the DAI it raised for the reserve is not subtracted. The later fake-staking-contract exploit is a different defect and stays a separate incident.
